notes: Overlay lag: the game mod searched every game object for behemoths every 2 s, player states every 5 s and parts every 10 s during a fight, on the game's own thread (each search pauses the game ~35 ms in your game, ~18 ms on a hunt server; up to ~245 ms at once). Now it searches only when a hit lands on a behemoth it does not know yet, re-links parts through their own components, does at most two searches per game frame, and a hunt server stops re-checking what it is. In a simulated 90 s fight: 106 searches down to 19 in your game, 148 to 36 on a hunt server. The mod log now notes the cost once a minute (game mod 7.5; close the game fully to load it).
